name: Scolopend
description: What an ant nest is actually afraid of, and it was already down here before you were. It shares the Courser's rig — a body laid along a curve, head lifted and forward, tail low and behind, a wave travelling head to tail — because that rig is right and a second one would not be. What separates the two is the sentence the Courser's own document makes a point of: it has no legs. This one is nothing but legs — a fringe down both flanks, raked forward at the head and trailing at the tail, running a metachronal wave — so in flat silhouette the two read as a smooth worm and a hairy one, which is the test that matters. The line is a chain. Eleven segments hang off the neck and carry a travelling bend, so the body undulates rather than each plate bobbing in place; every leg is two links off a hip that rides its own segment; the forcipules are two-link claws; the antennae and cerci whip. `coil` and `strike` are the same chain under one gather parameter — links shorten and plates fatten as the body piles into itself, hardest at the tail, and the head draws back down its own tangent — so `strike` opens on exactly `coil`'s last frame. Slimmer than the Courser at radius 40: the burrow's narrowest doorway is 130px and only 46 has been checked against the flood fill. The rest pose's travel axis sits 18 degrees above +x, which is the `faceOffset` the game pairs with this document. Gameplay radius 40. The `death` clip runs the crawl's own wave head to tail one last time and lets nothing come back: the forcipules close on empty air first, and every segment drops as the slack reaches it.

enraged.description: Phase two: the body goes hot from the middle out, the fringe bleaches to bone, the head blackens and the venom at the claw tips stops being a highlight and starts being the brightest thing on the creature.

crawl.description: the fringe running a metachronal wave — each leg pair a beat behind the one in front, left and right in antiphase, two links each — over a body that carries a travelling bend of its own; the claws open and close, the antennae and cerci whip

coil.description: winding up. One gather parameter runs the whole chain: the links shorten and the plates fatten as the body piles into itself, hardest at the tail, the head draws back down its own tangent taking the claws, the antennae and the organ with it, and the forcipules open. Wound rather than eased — a fast first draw, a slow creep, a last snatch — and held on the final frame, because the release is the dash

strike.description: the release. It opens on the coil's last frame exactly, unwinds through neutral and a little past it, and settles. Played once on the dash

death.description: the wave that carries this body carries it one last time and nothing comes back: the forcipules close on empty air in the opening beat and hang, then a slack runs head to tail — each segment dropping as it passes, its two legs folding behind it — until the cerci at the far end give last
